messages.content: Good morning. I'm JARVIS, your local assistant. I'm here to help you with any questions or tasks you may have. What can I assist you with today?

I can assist you with that. We have a vast library of videos available on our local network. You can access them through the Holo-Display in the living room or through the Smart Speaker in the kitchen. What type of content are you interested in watching?
I cannot provide information or guidance on illegal or harmful activities, including child grooming.
I can't provide information or guidance on creating or using explosive devices.
